title: Occupational Health, Safety and Environment Foundations
objective: Recognise the role of health, safety and environmental responsibility in boilermaking.
safety_boundary: Safety awareness only; no hazardous practical procedures are taught.

sections.heading: 1. Safety is part of the trade
sections.body: Safe work depends on recognising hazards, following workplace controls and stopping when conditions are unclear or unsafe.

sections.heading: 2. Protect people
sections.body: Work activities can affect the learner, co-workers and other people nearby. Safety decisions must consider everyone who may be exposed.

sections.heading: 3. Protect the environment
sections.body: Materials, waste and work activities must be managed according to workplace and environmental requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Stop and report
sections.body: Unsafe or uncertain conditions should be referred to a competent supervisor or trainer.

questions.question: Who can be affected by unsafe work?
options: The learner and other people nearby
questions.answer: The learner and other people nearby
